487: 7.2 Faction Rules and Abilities
488: 7.2.1     Crafting. The Eyrie craft before resolving the De­
489: cree during Daylight by activating roosts.
490: 7.2.2     Lords of the Forest. The Eyrie rule a clearing
491: when tied for most combined warriors and build­
492: ings there, and they have at least one Eyrie piece
493: there. L
494: 7.2.3     Disdain for Trade. Whenever the Eyrie craft an
495: item, they ignore the listed victory points and in­
496: stead score only one victory point. (They can still
497: score extra crafting points from effects such as Master
498: Engravers and the Legendary Forge.)
499: 7.3 Faction Setup
500: 7.3.1     Step 1: Gather Warriors. Form a supply of
501: 20 warriors.
502: 7.3.2     Step 2: Place Roost and Starting Warriors.
503: Place  1 roost and 6 warriors in a corner clearing
504: that is not the starting corner clearing of anoth­
505: er player and, if possible, is diagonally opposite
506: from a starting corner clearing. This is your start­
507: ing clearing. (This is updated from earlier printings
508: for flexibility.)
509: 7.3.3     Step 3: Choose Leader. Choose 1 of the 4 Eyrie
510: leader cards and place it in your Leader Card slot.
511: Gather the remaining leaders face up near you.
512: 7.3.4     Step 4: Tuck Viziers. Tuck your 2 Loyal Vizier
513: cards, showing their suit, into the Decree columns
514: above your faction board as listed on your leader.
515: 7.3.5     Step 5: Fill Roosts Track. Place your 6 remaining
516: roosts on your Roosts track from right to left.
517: 7.4 Birdsong
518: Your Birdsong has three steps in the following order.
519: 7.4.1     Emergency Orders. If you have no cards in your
520: hand, draw one card.
521: 7.4.2     Add to the Decree. You must add one or two cards
522: to the Decree, revealing them from your hand and
523: tucking them, but only one card added may be a
524: bird card. You may add each card to any column,
525: and each column can hold any number of cards.
526: 7.4.3     A New Roost. If you have no roosts on the map,
527: place a roost and three warriors in a clearing
528: with the fewest warriors where all those pieces
529: can be placed.
530: 7.5 Daylight
531: Your Daylight has two steps in the following order.
532: 7.5.1     Craft. You may activate roosts to craft cards from
533: your hand.
534: 7.5.2     Resolve the Decree. You must resolve the Decree,
535: starting with the leftmost column and moving
536: right. In each column, you must resolve all of its
537: cards, but in any order. For each card, you must
538: take the action listed for its column, as follows. If
539: you cannot fully take an action, you immediately
540: fall into turmoil (7.7).
541: 6.3.5     Step 5: Fill Buildings Tracks. Place your remain­
542: ing 5 sawmills, 5 workshops, and 5 recruiters on
543: the respective Buildings tracks from right to left.
544: (Leave the leftmost space of each track empty.)
545: 6.4 Birdsong
546: Place wood tokens in each clearing with any number of
547: sawmills, one wood per sawmill there.
548: 6.5 Daylight

550: your hand. Then, you may take up to three actions—
551: plus one action per bird card you spend (not as part of
552: an action)—in any order and number.

581: 7. Eyrie Dynasties E
582: 7.1 Overview
583: The Eyrie Dynasties wish to restore their once-
584: dignified kind to their former glory in the Woodland
585: by retaking control of the forest clearings. During
586: their Evening, the Eyrie score victory points based on
587: the number of roosts on the map. The greater their
588: presence in the Woodland, the greater their gains.
589: However, the Eyrie are bound by their decree, an ev­
590: er-increasing set of mandated actions promised by their
591: leader. Each turn, they must take all of the actions on
592: their Decree, or else fall into turmoil.

596: 8. Woodland Alliance A
597: 8.1 Overview
598: The Woodland Alliance works to gain the sympathy of
599: the various creatures of the Woodland who are dissatis­
600: fied with their present condition. Each time the Alliance
601: places a sympathy token, they may score victory points.
602: The more sympathy on the map they have, the more
603: victory points they score. Gaining the sympathy of the
604: people requires supporters. These supporters can also
605: be put toward violent ends, inciting outright rebellion
606: across the forest. When a revolt erupts, the Alliance will
607: establish a base. Bases allow the Alliance to train offi­
608: cers, increasing their military flexibility.
609: 8.2 Faction Rules and Abilities
610: 8.2.1     Crafting. The Alliance crafts during Daylight by
611: activating sympathy tokens.
612: 8.2.2     Guerrilla War. As defender in battle, the Alliance
613: will deal hits equal to the higher roll, and the at­
614: tacker will deal hits equal to the lower roll.
615: 8.2.3     The Supporters Stack. To take various actions,
616: the Alliance spends supporters, which are cards
617: on their Supporters stack. Supporters can only be
618: spent for their suit and do not count against the
619: Alliance’s hand size. Supporters are face down,
620: but the Alliance may inspect them at any time.
621: I     Capacity. If the Alliance has no bases on the
622: map, the Supporters stack can only hold up
623: to five cards. If the Alliance would gain a sup­
624: porter but the stack cannot hold it, that card
625: is discarded. If any bases are on the map, the
626: Supporters stack can hold unlimited cards.
627: 8.2.4     Removing Bases. Whenever a base is removed,
628: the Alliance must discard all supporters matching
629: the clearing of the base (including birds) and re­
630: move half of their officers, rounded up. If the Alli­
631: ance has no more bases on the map and has more
632: than five supporters, they must discard down to
633: five supporters.
634: 8.2.5     Sympathy Tokens. The Alliance has 10 sympa­
635: thy tokens.
636: I     Placement Limits. A clearing can hold only
637: one sympathy token.
638: II     Terms. A sympathetic clearing is one with a
639: sympathy token. An unsympathetic clearing
640: is one without a sympathy token.
641: 8.2.6     Outrage. Whenever another player removes a
642: sympathy token or moves any warriors into a sym­
643: pathetic clearing, they must add one card match­
644: ing the affected clearing from their hand to the
645: Supporters stack. If they have no matching cards
646: (including no birds), they must show their hand to
647: the Alliance, and then the Alliance draws a card
648: from the deck and adds it to the Supporters stack.
649: I     Recruit. Place a warrior in any clearing with a
650: roost whose suit matches the card suit.
651: II     Move. Move from any clearing whose suit
652: matches the card suit. (You must move at least
653: one warrior.)
654: III     Battle. Initiate a battle in any clearing whose
655: suit matches the card suit.
656: IV     Build. Place a roost in any clearing you rule
657: whose suit matches the card suit and which has
658: no roost.
659: 7.6 Evening
660: Your Evening has two steps in the following order.
661: 7.6.1     Score Points. Score the victory points listed on
662: the rightmost empty space of your Roosts track.
663: 7.6.2     Draw and Discard. Draw one card, plus one card
664: per uncovered draw bonus. Then, if you have
665: more than five cards in your hand, discard cards
666: of your choice until you have five.
667: 7.7 Turmoil
668: If you cannot fully take an action in the Decree (7.5.2)
669: for any reason, you fall into turmoil. You must take the
670: Turmoil action as follows in order.
671: 7.7.1     Step 1: Humiliate. Lose one victory point per
672: bird card (including Loyal Viziers) on the Decree.
673: 7.7.2     Step 2: Purge. Discard all of the cards on the De­
674: cree except your Loyal Viziers.
675: 7.7.3     Step 3: Depose. Flip your current leader face
676: down and set it aside, choose a new leader from
677: those face up, and place on your faction board.
678: Tuck your Loyal Viziers into the Decree spaces
679: listed on your new leader.
680: I     A New Clutch. If you must choose a new lead­
681: er but none are face up, flip them all face up.
682: 7.7.4     Step 4: Rest. End Daylight and begin Evening.
683: 7.8 Leaders Reference
684: The Eyrie have four leader cards, as follows.
685: 7.8.1     Builder. Loyal Viziers begin on Recruit and Move.
686: Whenever you craft, you ignore your Disdain for
687: Trade special ability (7.2.3).
688: 7.8.2     Charismatic. Loyal Viziers begin on Recruit and
689: Battle. Whenever you take a Recruit action, you
690: must place two warriors instead of one.
691: 7.8.3     Commander. Loyal Viziers begin on Move and
692: Battle. In battle as attacker, you deal an extra hit.
693: 7.8.4     Despot. Loyal Viziers begin on Move and Build.
694: Whenever you remove at least one enemy build­
695: ing or token in battle, you score one extra victory
696: point (two in total, 3.2.1).
